lead: Five tokens, one is a rug pull. Mevrouw Mintje shows you the public data. Can you find the scam before it takes the money? Five rounds, each one harder.
fake: All tokens here are made up. Real tokens can rug even without these flags, and no flags never means safe. Not financial advice.
pick: Which one is the rug pull? Tap it.
a1: A crypto scam where the people behind a token take the money out, for example by pulling the liquidity, printing new tokens or blocking sales. The price crashes to almost zero and buyers cannot get out.
q2: Which red flags point to a rug pull?
a2: Mint authority still on, freeze authority still on, liquidity that is not locked or burned, very thin liquidity, one creator or a few wallets holding most of the supply, and many buys with zero sells (a honeypot). No flags does not mean safe.
q3: How do I check a real token?
a3: Paste its address in the free Token Checkup, or look at the live red flags in the MAIGA Radar. Both read public data only. It is a checklist, not financial advice.
